disclaimer: Demonstration criteria only. Each bank sets its own lending policy, interest rates and security requirements.

rules.label: Applicant age between 21 and 65
rules.failMessage: The applicant's age is outside the 21–65 range used in this demo policy.
rules.suggestion: A younger family member could apply as co-applicant.

rules.label: Total repayments at most 50% of monthly income
rules.failMessage: Monthly repayments, including existing loans, would be more than half of monthly income.
rules.suggestion: Reduce the amount, choose a longer repayment period, or close an existing loan first.

rules.label: Loan at most 3 times yearly income
rules.failMessage: The loan requested is more than 3 times yearly income.

rules.label: No missed or defaulted loan payments
rules.failMessage: Past loans show missed or defaulted payments.
rules.suggestion: Regularise overdue loans and keep repayments on time before applying again.

rules.label: Loan up to ₹1,60,000, or collateral covering the full amount
rules.failMessage: Loans above ₹1,60,000 need security worth at least the loan amount in this demo policy.
rules.suggestion: Offer collateral worth at least the loan amount, or reduce the loan to ₹1,60,000.

rules.label: At least 2 years of farming experience
rules.failMessage: Less than 2 years of farming experience.
rules.suggestion: A guarantor or a smaller first loan may help.
